findings.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT ... EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
findings.rationale: Cap is one-sided (vendor only), ambiguous in scope, while Client's indemnity is uncapped; no carve-outs for confidentiality, data misuse, security incidents; no mutual consequential damages waiver.

findings.quote: without regard to any knowledge limitation or qualification that may be contained in this Agreement
findings.rationale: No vendor IP infringement indemnity at all; Client indemnity is broad, uncapped, not limited to third-party claims, and strips negotiated knowledge qualifiers; no indemnification procedures.

findings.quote: Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface.
findings.rationale: Mandatory purchase from vendor creates exclusivity commitment, with pricing in an unattached side agreement and in tension with p0022.

findings.quote: but not less than $____ per month for the Hosting Services and $____ per month for Support Services
findings.rationale: Blank monthly minimums bind Client to unspecified spend, plus a per-borrower credit report volume commitment.

findings.quote: rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party
findings.rationale: MFN in Client's favour but with no verification mechanism; price protection limited to one year and hosting only.

findings.quote: EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT, TRUELINK DISCLAIMS ANY AND ALL EXPENSES WARRANTIES
findings.rationale: Only obsolete Y2K warranty and unmeasurable standard of care; no conformity, non-infringement, malicious code, security or legal-compliance warranty, and no remedy.

findings.quote: Sections 2 and 3 level shall terminate promptly upon (a) any action or omission by Client or any of its customers
findings.rationale: Instant termination/cutoff for third-party acts with no notice or cure; Client lacks termination rights for vendor material breach, insolvency, security incident, or loss of repository licences; cross-references broken.

findings.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods ... unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
findings.rationale: Auto-renewal with only 30 days' notice and uncapped renewal pricing after one-year price protection expires.

findings.quote: Client is responsible for arranging for a new hosting environment within 60 days.
findings.rationale: No vendor transition assistance, no data return/export or certified deletion obligation; migration burden entirely on Client with inconsistent 30/60-day deadlines.

findings.quote: Client hereby grants to TrueLink the nonexclusive worldwide right and license to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data
findings.rationale: Broad vendor rights over Client/borrower data (perpetual via survival clause); customizations addressed only as confidential information, with vendor retaining all Interface ownership and no Client ownership/licence of paid deliverables.

findings.quote: TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface
findings.rationale: Grant runs to Client only with no affiliate/broker sublicense despite recitals; vendor may unilaterally change compatibility specs; no escrow/continuity right.

findings.quote: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate
findings.rationale: Undefined 'affiliate' exception, no assumption requirement, and no change-of-control trigger allowing a competitor to acquire TrueLink with Client data.

findings.quote: resolved solely and exclusively in the state or federal courts located within San Luis Obispo County, California
findings.rationale: Exclusive venue in vendor's home county with forum non conveniens waiver plus prevailing-party fee shifting increases Client's dispute cost.
Agreement contains no vendor insurance obligation despite vendor custody of consumer credit files.

findings.quote: TrueLink will backup the Interface and all data files associated with it at least once each day
findings.rationale: No Client audit/security assessment or regulatory examination right, and no verification mechanism for the most-favoured-rate covenant.
